title: IPsec VPN: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Picture an armoured convoy. It protects the cargo, and checks it hasn't been touched. That's what I P sec does for packets.

scenes.heading: The armoured convoy
scenes.narration: I P sec builds the convoy in two phases. Phase one agrees the rules, using I K E on U D P five hundred. Phase two builds the tunnel that carries the data. E S P encrypts and checks the data. The crypto lists on each side must mirror each other.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. I K E uses U D P. E S P can encrypt and authenticate. They must be mirror images.

items.wrong: AH is more secure than ESP

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. I K E phase one, then phase two. E S P encrypts and checks data. Crypto lists must mirror each other. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva IPsec lab.
